questions.q: What kind of clothes do you like to wear?
questions.answer: I tend to keep it simple and comfortable, mostly casual shirts and jeans. I'm not one for chasing trends. As long as something is neat and [[versatile]], I'm perfectly happy with it.

questions.q: Do you wear different clothes at work and at home?
questions.answer: Yes, quite different. At work I wear formal shirts and trousers, since a [[polished]] appearance matters when meeting students and parents. At home, though, I change straight into something loose and comfortable.

questions.q: Do you ever wear traditional clothes?
questions.answer: Yes, mostly on special occasions. For Eid and weddings I always wear a panjabi, which is a long traditional shirt. I really enjoy it, because it feels festive and connects me to our [[cultural roots]].

questions.q: Do you spend a lot on clothes?
questions.answer: Not really. I buy new clothes mainly before Eid or when something wears out. I'd rather invest in a few good-quality items than lots of cheap ones that quickly lose their shape, as it's more [[economical]] in the long run.

questions.q: Have clothing styles in your country changed much?
questions.answer: Considerably, especially among young people. Western styles like jeans and T-shirts are now everyday wear in towns and cities. Even so, traditional clothing remains [[deeply ingrained]], particularly during festivals and family celebrations.
